mechanism_narrative: Sustained week-over-week improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT mobility signals a steady return of commuting and out-of-home routines, which mechanically raises weekday retail-and-recreation footfall over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -9.7 at t-3w to -8.4 at t-0w
fact:TRANSIT rose from -30.0 at t-3w to -27.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days when WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of TRANSIT above -28 percent of baseline after four weeks below that level signals a discrete policy-relevant recovery in public mobility, which unlocks retail trips and lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT > -28 at t-0w after being <= -29 in at least two of the prior three weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT was -30.0, -29.6, -31.0, -27.3 across t-3w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is lower than over the last 14 days after TRANSIT crosses above -28.

mechanism_narrative: The sharp PARKS rebound from -27.3 to -16.9 together with a falling RESIDENTIAL series indicates households are moving time from home to out-of-home leisure, which spills over into retail-and-recreation within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -27.3 at t-1w to -16.9 at t-0w
fact:RESIDENTIAL fell from 6.6 at t-3w to 3.7 at t-0w
failure_condition: In the next 7 days, RETAIL_REC does not rise relative to the prior 7 days when PARKS rebounds by at least 5 points and RESIDENTIAL falls.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-restriction normalisation regime, a rising WORKPLACES series is the dominant driver of retail recovery because office attendance restores lunchtime and after-work retail demand over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved every week from -9.7 to -8.4
failure_condition: Within the post-restriction normalisation regime, RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days while WORKPLACES continues to rise.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GROCERY_PHARM from 2.3 to 1.3 signals reduced household provisioning and a shift toward cautious discretionary spending, which drags RETAIL_REC lower over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below 1.5 from above 2.0 four weeks earlier
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declined from 2.3 at t-3w to 1.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days after GROCERY_PHARM falls below 1.5.

mechanism_narrative: Springtime outdoor demand shown by PARKS above -20 while RESIDENTIAL falls pulls discretionary time into parks and away from indoor retail, suppressing RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS is -16.9 at t-0w while RESIDENTIAL is 3.7
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is higher than over the last 14 days when PARKS is above -20 and RESIDENTIAL is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous recovery in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES creates a reinforcing commute-and-errand loop that lifts RETAIL_REC over four weeks; neither series alone is sufficient.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by >1 point and WORKPLACES improves by >0.2 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose 3.7 points and WORKPLACES rose 1.3 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days when TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: If policy remains unchanged and RESIDENTIAL stays above zero while falling, the slow release of home-bound time supports incremental retail recovery, but only when TRANSIT does not deteriorate, yielding higher RETAIL_REC in four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL between 3.0 and 5.0 and TRANSIT > -30 at t-0w
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL is 3.7 and TRANSIT is -27.3 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than over the last 28 days when RESIDENTIAL is between 3.0 and 5.0 and TRANSIT remains above -30.
